title: Quenched Canadian Shiitake Mushrooms En-Croute
description: A post-workout dish featuring shiitake mushrooms and anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a pan, sauté the shiitake mushrooms in olive oil until tender.
Add garlic and sauté for another minute.
In a bowl, mix together flour, thyme, and parmesan cheese.
Add the mushroom mixture to the bowl and mix well.
Roll out puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the mushroom mixture in the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around it.
Brush the edges of the pastry with water and fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Let the pastry cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
